[42899 Applied Data Analytics for Cybersecurity | Subject description]
Credit points: 2

Applied Data Analytics for Cybersecurity integrates big data and threat intelligence for detecting and mitigating insider and external cyber threats. You will explore emerging challenges such as malware analysis, adversarial machine learning, and privacy-preserving data analytics. The subject introduces artificial intelligence technologies relevant to cybersecurity and common data analytic approaches, providing hands-on experience in identifying risks and securing corporate IT networks.

[42899 Applied Data Analytics for Cybersecurity | Learning and teaching activities]
Microcredential presentation includes weekly synchronous one-hour online workshops facilitated by an expert UTS academic(s) supporting self-study and online (LMS) learning activities. Case studies of real-world business illustrate applications of data analytics techniques in cybersecurity. The workshop sessions focus on hands-on experience in cybersecurity and data analytics tools, and the understanding and interpretation of the results. Regular formative quizzes throughout the semester will allow learners to gauge their progress.
